feature: A small SVG icon opens big enough to work on
summary: A small square SVG now opens as an Icon picture, the same size a 24 unit icon opens, instead of a speck. It keeps its own units, so a 16 by 16 file reads and writes 16 units.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/a-small-svg-opens-big-enough-walk.json.

try.do: Open a 16 by 16 SVG with File, Open.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Command Plus, then Command 0, and check you land on the same view.
Click one line of the icon with the Select tool.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Read Width in the panel and the place label on the canvas: they are in the file's units.
Export it as SVG and check the file says viewBox 0 0 16 16.

try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

evaluate: Is the icon big enough to work on as it opens, or should it grow to the full height of the window?
Is 64 the right top size, or should a 96 or 128 point square file open as an icon too?
Should a small file that is not square, such as 20 by 16, also open bigger?
rough: The icon does not literally fill the window. It opens at 512 points, the view a 24 unit icon gets: 59 percent of the canvas height in a 1280 by 900 window and 67 percent in 1100 by 800.
A small file that is not square still opens at 100 percent as a speck, and so does a square file over 64 points or under 8.
Ask's own drawing lands on 24 units. On a picture of another grid that was not tried, so it may land between that picture's units.
The Actual sizes card sits over the top left corner of the canvas at 1280 wide. A 24 unit icon shows the same overlap, so this change did not cause it.
No mock covers opening a small SVG file.
